items.title: Jack Kerrigan Interview, 1958-05-04
items.q: they had the old P-ROM band playing there every Sunday... every Saturday... on into Sunday morning

ctx.x: I have been requested by Haywood Haley to give you some history on the New Orleans Jazz of the city of New Orleans. This is Jack Kerrigan speaking. I was born March of 18, 1900, and my first contact with jazz was when I lived in Hammond around 19... 17 at the old Oaks Hotel. Saturday night dances used to be given quite often and my first opportunity to hear the New Orleans Jazz was given... was played by a band from Baton Rouge known as Johnson's Band. Later on after finishing my high school in Hammond I moved to…

remember... if at any time... they... stopped... using it... at... at... at... at parties... and then... when... it started again... when... if people... stopped liking it... and stopped listening to it... then started again... you know... like... the death of jazz... and the revival... in the... early 40's... and so on... do you... remember anything? moved away from...
